subject: Request: post-remediation validation sweep and evidence package
messages:
From: Jared Mills <jared.mills@acme-corp.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-fix validation sweep request

Camila —

Thanks again for the remediation updates. We kicked off an internal review of the items in the original pen test and noted a few that were marked resolved by your team. Before we close the ticket on our side we need: a) an executable list of the changes (short remediation summary with file/commit references if available), b) a set of sample logs or traces showing the fix in production, and c) a proposed re-validation window where we (or our third-party tester) can re-run the original checks.

Goal: have the validation completed and a brief delta attestation from Redwood the week of Apr 12 if possible. Can you confirm whether the week of Apr 12-16 works for you and provide the artifact set we requested? If you can also include a one-page confirmation letter that we can attach to our audit record, that would be ideal.

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Jared
Jared Mills
Security Lead, Acme Cloud
security@acme-corp.com


On Thu, Apr 1, 2027 at 08:18 AM Jared Mills <jared.mills@acme-corp.com> wrote: > Follow-up: we also need to know whether authentication logs for the affected service will be retained for at least 30 days during the re-scan.

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jared Mills <jared.mills@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-fix validation sweep request -- ACME

Team — forwarding ACME's ask (below). Jared is requesting:
- remediation summary (with commits or ticket ids)
- sample logs/traces showing fixes in production
- proposed validation window (they prefer Apr 12-16)
- one-page confirmation letter/delta attestation after their re-scan

Vivek: can you compile the remediation matrix and pull the relevant logs? If we can provide a compact evidence bundle and a short verification letter I will lock in the Apr 13 slot with ACME.

Marissa: please prepare a one-page customer-facing attestation template I can sign off on once Vivek confirms artifacts. Also flag any operational risks running the re-scan on production (rate limits, sampling).

Attachments: redwood_remediation_matrix_v1.xlsx (WIP)

Thanks — Camila

--

On Thu, 01 Apr 2027 at 09:12 AM Jared Mills <jared.mills@acme-corp.com> wrote: > Camila — > > Thanks again for the remediation updates...

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jared Mills <jared.mills@acme-corp.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-fix validation sweep request -- ACME

Camila / Jared —

Quick status from Security Engineering:
- Remediation matrix: completed for 9/9 findings from the original test. Matrix entries include PR numbers (internal) and the associated infra change-IDs. See attached spreadsheet (redwood_remediation_matrix_v1.xlsx).
- Evidence: we can produce a focused evidence bundle that contains (a) pre/post config diffs, (b) sampled auth and API request logs for the affected endpoints (30-day window), (c) container image provenance and signed digests, and (d) the patch/rollout runbook. Bundle stub: evidence_bundle_sample-logs.tar.gz (contents: logs/ config_diff/ image_manifests/ runbook.md).
- Re-scan window: engineering availability for an externally-driven re-validation is Apr 13 (09:00-12:00 PT) and Apr 14 (13:00-16:00 PT). We recommend Apr 13 morning for a quick interactive sweep and Apr 14 for a deeper follow-up if they want.
- Operational constraints: we will run with read-only sampling of auth logs (no traffic injection). Rate-limited endpoints will be excluded from automated fuzzing; we can provide a whitelisted test token if ACME's tester requires active probes.

I'll prepare the delta attestation and a short verification letter template this week; Marissa, can you assemble the customer-facing one-pager from the draft in /templates/security/attestations? Camila, once we confirm artifacts I'll upload the full bundle to the shared Drive link and we can trigger a signed DocuSign for the verification letter.

Attachments: redwood_remediation_matrix_v1.xlsx, evidence_bundle_sample-logs.tar.gz
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcme-PostRemediation

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Security Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Hi Jared —

Thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can confirm the initial re-validation window on Apr 13, 2027 from 09:00-12:00 PT. Vivek's team will provide a focused evidence bundle ahead of the scan (link below) and Marissa is finalizing the one-page delta attestation.

What to expect next:
- Today: we will upload the evidence bundle to the Drive link and share a short readme called validation-sweep-instructions.pdf that describes artifact locations and contact points.
- Apr 12 (EOD): ACME and/or your tester will receive the full evidence bundle link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcme-PostRemediation
- Apr 13 (09:00-12:00 PT): re-validation sweep (interactive). Redwood will stand by on slack/zoom for any clarifications.
- After completion: Redwood will provide a delta attestation and a signed verification letter (PDF/DocuSign) within 3 business days.

Attachments (uploaded): evidence_bundle_sample-logs.tar.gz, validation-sweep-instructions.pdf

Please confirm the Apr 13 morning slot and let us know if you prefer we send a whitelisted test token for active probes.

Best —
